_comment: Shop chains, so the counter header shows whose shop you are standing in rather
id        internal name, for the log.
logo      a file in data/icons. Brand marks are FULL COLOUR, unlike the product
roomKeys  interior room keys this chain uses. THE GOOD SIGNAL -- every branch of
a chain shares one interior asset, so one key brands all of them.
at        positions known to be inside one. The fallback until a key is known.
radius    how far from one of those positions still counts. Metres.
HOW TO ADD THE KEY. Stand at the counter once and Bare Minimum writes the room key
of wherever you are to BareMinimum.log:
Counter room key: 123456789  (put this in data/brands.json under roomKeys ...)
Paste that number into roomKeys for the chain and every branch of it is branded, no
rebuild needed. Until then the position below covers the one store it names.
